name: University of Windsor
description: The University of Windsor is a public comprehensive university in Windsor, Ontario, across the river from Detroit, with about 17,000 students.
whyIncluded: A fast-growing destination for international master's students in Canada: its international share rose from 10% to 22% of students by 2021, mostly at master's level, and it fixes tuition for each entering cohort.

livingCosts.summary: Windsor's own 2026-27 residence and meal plan charges for an 8-month year. Local transit is in the compulsory fees; personal costs are not covered.
livingCosts.notes: UWindsor fee estimator, residence option: Laurier Hall single room CA$4,521 per term and 7-day meal plan CA$3,790 per term; 2 terms over 8 months. No personal-expense estimate published, so personal 0; the student transit pass is in compulsory fees.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science in Mechanical Engineering
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for international students starting in 2026, fixed for your degree under Windsor's tuition guarantee, plus compulsory student fees.
programmes.notes: UWindsor fee estimator ('approved fees for 2026-2027'), international full-time, program category Engineering: base tuition CA$22,050.00 'assessed each term'; annual = 2 terms. One-off First Year Transition fee CA$90. Compulsory fees = the estimator's non-tuition fees for 10 courses (Student Centre per-course fee x10) over the year = CA$1,752.10; excludes international health insurance (985.09 a year undergraduate) and co-op fees. Only 2026-2027 is published, so no fee history. cohortLocked: the UWindsor Tuition Guarantee (https://ask.uwindsor.ca/app/answers/detail/a_id/743/kw/tuition%20guarantee) keeps base tuition unchanged for each entering cohort.
